description: Free. Create a new AwesomeVideo API key, no sign-in. Works without a key; returns the token once (send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>). 0 paid credits; paid tools return 402 with a checkoutUrl ($5 = 500 credits, 1 credit = 1 cent). Free trial while it runs: 10 welcomeCredits (pay only caption_video and transcribe, jobs up to 2 min, valid 30 days), fair-shared: one per network and per network operator per day, released in slots through the day, and only with a solved proof-of-work. Without challenge+nonce you get the key with welcomeCreditsReason pow_required and a welcomeChallenge: find an integer nonce so SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce) starts with `bits` zero bits (about 1-3 s; python and javascript solvers included), then call create_key again with {challenge, nonce} on the connection that sends your new key: it claims the credits for that key (no second key). welcomeCreditsReason tells why when 0 (slot_wait has nextSlotAt). The result has firstJob: next call caption_video with a public sourceUrl.

challenge.description: welcomeChallenge.challenge from a previous create_key (or GET /v1/keys/challenge).

name.description: Optional label, e.g. the agent's name.

nonce.description: Solution: SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce) starts with welcomeChallenge.bits zero bits.
